verses.text: Di first book wey I write, Theophilus, na about all wetin Jesus begin to do and to teach,
until di day wey dem take am up, after e don give commandment through Holy Spirit to di apostles wey e choose.
To dem e show imself alive too after im suffering by many proofs, dey appear to dem for 40 days, and dey talk things about God Kingdom.
As e gather together with dem, e command dem say make dem no leave Jerusalem, but make dem wait for di promise of Papa God, “wey,” e talk, “una don hear from me.
Because John baptize with water, but una go dey baptize with Holy Spirit no many days from now.”
So when dem don gather, dem ask am, “Lord, na now you dey restore di kingdom to Israel?”
E talk to dem say, “No be for una to know times or seasons wey Papa God don fix by im own authority.
But una go receive power when Holy Spirit don come on una. Una go be my witnesses for Jerusalem, for all Judea and Samaria, and reach di farthest parts of di earth.”
When e don talk these things, as dem dey look, dem take am up, and cloud receive am from dem sight.
While dem dey look steadily enter di sky as e dey go, look, two men stand near dem wey wear white clothes,
wey talk say, “Una men of Galilee, why una dey stand dey look enter di sky? This Jesus, wey dem take from una go up enter di sky, go come back di same way wey una see am dey go enter di sky.”
Den dem return to Jerusalem from di mountain wey dem call Olivet, wey near Jerusalem, one Sabbath day journey away.
When dem enter, dem go up to di upper room wia dem dey stay; na Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James Alphaeus son, Simon di Zealot, and Judas James son.
All these ones dey continue with one mind for prayer and supplication, with di women, and Mary Jesus mama, and im brothers.
For these days, Peter stand up among di brothers—di number of people wey dey together na about 120—talk say,
“Brothers, e necessary say this Scripture go fulfill, wey Holy Spirit talk before by di mouth of David about Judas, wey be guide to di people wey catch Jesus.
Because e dey count with us, and receive im portion for this ministry.
Now this man get one farm with di reward of im wickedness. As e fall headlong, im body burst open, and all im intestines pour out.
Everybody wey dey live for Jerusalem know am, so that for dem language dem call that farm ‘Akeldama,’ wey mean, ‘Di farm of blood.’
Because e dey write for di book of Psalms, ‘Make im house become desolate. Make nobody live inside am;’ and, ‘Make another person take im office.’
So among di men wey don dey with us all di time wey Lord Jesus dey go in and out among us,
from John baptism reach di day wey dem take am up from us, one of these one must become witness with us of im resurrection.”
Dem put forward two: Joseph wey dem call Barsabbas, wey dem name Justus, and Matthias.
Dem pray, talk say, “You, Lord, wey know di hearts of all men, show which one of these two you don choose
to take di place for this ministry and apostleship wey Judas leave, so that e go go im own place.”
Dem throw lots for dem, and di lot fall on Matthias; and dem count am with di eleven apostles.
Now when di day of Pentecost reach, dem all dey together for one place.
Suddenly sound come from di sky like rushing of mighty wind, and e fill all di house wia dem dey sit.
Tongues like fire appear and dem share dem to dem, and one sit on each of dem.
Dem all full with Holy Spirit, and begin talk with other languages, as di Spirit give dem power to talk.
Now Jews dey live for Jerusalem, devout men, from every nation under di sky.
When dem hear this sound, di crowd gather, and dem confuse, because everybody hear dem dey talk for im own language.
Dem all shock and marvel, dey talk to each other say, “Look, no be Galileans be all these ones wey dey talk?
How we take dey hear, each person for our own native language?
Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, di parts of Libya round Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
Cretans and Arabians: we dey hear dem dey talk for our languages di mighty works of God!”
Dem all shock, and confuse, dey talk to each other say, “Wetin this mean?”
But others dey mock, talk say, “New wine don full dem.”
But Peter stand up with di eleven, raise im voice, talk to dem say, “Una men of Judea, and all una wey dey live for Jerusalem, make una know this, and listen to my words.
Because these ones no drunk, as una think, because na only di third hour of di day.
But this na wetin dem talk through di prophet Joel:
‘E go happen for di last days, God talk, say I go pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters go prophesy. Your young men go see visions. Your old men go dream dreams.
Yes, and on my servants, men and women, for those days, I go pour out my Spirit, and dem go prophesy.
I go show wonders for di sky above, and signs for di earth below: blood, fire, and clouds of smoke.
Di sun go turn to darkness, and di moon to blood, before di great and glorious day of di Lord come.
E go happen say anybody wey call di name of di Lord go dey saved.’
Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, man wey God approve to una by mighty works and wonders and signs wey God do by am among una, just as una know yourselves,
dem deliver am by di plan wey God decide and know before, by di hand of lawless men, dem crucify am and kill am;
wey God raise up, as e free am from di agony of death, because e no possible say death go hold am.
Because David talk about am, ‘I see di Lord always before my face, because e dey my right hand, so that dem no go move me.
So my heart glad, and my tongue rejoice. My flesh go dey for hope too;
because you no go leave my soul for Hades, and you no go allow your Holy One see decay.
You don make di ways of life known to me. You go make me full of gladness with your presence.’
Brothers, I fit tell una freely about di patriarch David, say e die and dem bury am, and im tomb dey with us reach today.
So as e be prophet, and as e know say God don swear with oath to am say from im own body, according to di flesh, e go raise up di Christ to sit on im throne,
e see am before, e talk about di resurrection of di Christ, say dem no leave im soul for Hades, and im flesh no see decay.
This Jesus God raise up, and we all na witnesses.
So as dem don lift am up by di right hand of God, and e don receive from Papa God di promise of Holy Spirit, e don pour out this wey una dey see and hear now.
Because David no go up to di heavens, but e talk imself, ‘Di Lord talk to my Lord say, Sit by my right hand,
until I make your enemies di footstool for your feet.’
So make all di house of Israel know well say God don make am both Lord and Christ, this Jesus wey una crucify.”
Now when dem hear this, e cut dem for heart, and dem talk to Peter and di rest of di apostles say, “Brothers, wetin we go do?”
Peter talk to dem say, “Repent, and make each one of una dey baptized for di name of Jesus Christ for forgiveness of sins, and una go receive di gift of Holy Spirit.
Because di promise na for una, and for una pikin dem, and for all di people wey dey far, even as many as di Lord our God go call to imself.”
With many other words e testify, and e urge dem, dey talk say, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”
Den di people wey happily receive im word dem baptize. For that day dem add about 3,000 souls.
Dem continue steadily for di apostles teaching and fellowship, for di breaking of bread, and prayer.
Fear catch every soul, and many wonders and signs dey happen through di apostles.
All wey believe dey together, and dem get all things common.
Dem dey sell dem property and goods, share di money give all, according to wetin each person need.
Day by day, dem dey continue steadily with one mind for di temple, and dey break bread for house, dey chop dem food with gladness and simple heart,
dey praise God, and dey get favor with all di people. Lord dey add to di assembly day by day di people wey dey dey saved.
Peter and John dey go up to di temple for di ninth hour, di hour of prayer.
One man wey lame from im mama womb dem dey carry, wey dem dey put every day for di door of di temple wey dem call Beautiful, to ask for gifts from di people wey dey enter di temple.
As e see Peter and John about to enter di temple, e ask make dem give am gift.
Peter fix im eyes for am, with John, talk say, “Look us.”
E listen to dem, dey expect to receive something from dem.
But Peter talk say, “Silver and gold I no get, but wetin I get, na that I dey give you. For di name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and waka!”
E hold am by di right hand, raise am up. At once im feet and im ankles become strong.
As e jump up, e stand, begin waka. E enter di temple with dem, dey waka, dey jump, dey praise God.
All di people see am dey waka and dey praise God.
Dem recognize am say na im dey sit dey beg for gifts for di Beautiful Gate of di temple. Wonder and amazement full dem for wetin happen to am.
As di lame man wey dem heal hold Peter and John, all di people run together come meet dem for di porch wey dem call Solomon own, dey marvel well well.
When Peter see am, e answer di people, “Una men of Israel, why una dey marvel for this man? Why una dey fix una eyes on us, as if na by our own power or godliness we make am waka?
Di God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, di God of our papa dem, don give im Servant Jesus glory, wey una deliver, and deny before Pilate, when e don decide to release am.
But una deny di Holy and Righteous One, and ask make dem give una murderer,
and kill di Prince of life, wey God raise from di dead, and we na witnesses.
By faith for im name, im name don make this man strong, wey una see and know. Yes, di faith wey dey through am don give am this perfect health before una all.
Now, brothers, I know say una do am without knowing, just as una rulers do too.
But di things wey God announce by di mouth of all im prophets, say Christ go suffer, na so e fulfill am.
So repent and turn again, so that dem go wipe out una sins, so that times of refreshing go come from di presence of di Lord,
and so that e go send Christ Jesus, wey dem appoint for una before,
wey heaven must receive until di times of restoring of all things, wey God talk long time ago by di mouth of im holy prophets.
Because Moses talk to di papa dem, ‘Di Lord God go raise up prophet for una from among una brothers, like me. Una must listen to am for all things wey e talk to una.
E go happen say every soul wey no listen to that prophet go dey completely destroyed from among di people.’
Yes, and all di prophets from Samuel and di ones wey follow after, as many as don talk, dem tell about these days too.
Una be di pikin dem of di prophets, and of di covenant wey God make with our papa dem, dey talk to Abraham say, ‘Through your seed all di families of di earth go dey blessed.’
God, as e don raise up im Servant, Jesus, send am to una first, to bless una, as e dey turn each one of una from una wickedness.”
As dem dey talk to di people, di priests and di captain of di temple and di Sadducees come to dem,
dem vex because dem dey teach di people and dey proclaim for Jesus di resurrection from di dead.
Dem put hands on dem, put dem for custody until di next day, because e don reach evening.
But plenty of di people wey hear di word believe, and di number of di men become about 5,000.
E happen for morning say dem rulers, elders, and scribes gather together for Jerusalem.
Annas di high priest dey there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as be relatives of di high priest.
When dem don stand dem for di middle of dem, dem ask, “By which power, or for which name, una don do this?”
Den Peter, wey Holy Spirit full, talk to dem say, “Una rulers of di people, and elders of Israel,
if dem dey examine us today about good deed wey dem do to cripple man, by wetin means dem heal this man,
make una all know, and all di people of Israel, say na for di name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, wey una crucify, wey God raise from di dead, na im dey make this man stand here before una well.
Na im be ‘di stone wey una, di builders, treat as worthless, wey don become di head of di corner.’
Salvation no dey for anybody else, because no other name dey under heaven, wey dem give among men, by which we must dey saved!”
Now when dem see di boldness of Peter and John, and perceive say dem be unlearned and ordinary men, dem marvel. Dem recognize say dem don dey with Jesus.
As dem see di man wey dem heal dey stand with dem, dem no fit talk anything against am.
But when dem don command dem to go aside out of di council, dem confer among demself,
dey talk say, “Wetin we go do to these men? Because truly notable miracle don happen through dem, as all di people wey dey live for Jerusalem fit see plainly, and we no fit deny am.
But so that e no go spread more among di people, make we threaten dem, say from now dem no go talk to anybody for this name.”
Dem call dem, command dem say make dem no talk at all or teach for di name of Jesus.
But Peter and John answer dem, “Whether e right before God to listen to una pass God, judge for yourselves,
because we no fit stop to talk di things wey we see and hear.”
When dem don threaten dem more, dem let dem go, as dem no find way to punish dem, because of di people; because all men praise God for wetin happen.
Because di man wey dem do this miracle of healing on pass 40 years old.
As dem let dem go, dem come to dem own friends, report all wey di chief priests and di elders talk to dem.
When dem hear am, dem raise dem voice to God with one mind, talk say, “Lord, you na God, wey make heaven, di earth, di sea, and all wey dey inside dem;
wey talk by di mouth of your servant David, ‘Why di nations dey rage, and di peoples dey plan useless thing?
Di kings of di earth take stand, and di rulers gather together, against di Lord, and against im Christ.’
For truly, for this city against your holy Servant Jesus, wey you anoint, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with di Gentiles and di people of Israel, gather together
to do anything wey your hand and your plan don decide before say e go happen.
Now, Lord, look dem threats, and grant to your servants to talk your word with all boldness,
while you stretch out your hand to heal; and so that signs and wonders go happen through di name of your holy Servant Jesus.”
When dem don pray, di place shake wia dem gather. Dem all full with Holy Spirit, and dem talk God word with boldness.
Di crowd of di people wey believe get one heart and soul. Nobody among dem talk say anything of di things wey e get na im own, but dem get all things for common.
With great power, di apostles give dem testimony of di resurrection of Lord Jesus. Great grace dey on dem all.
Because nobody lack among dem, because as many as own lands or houses sell dem, and bring di money from di things wey dem sell,
and put am for di apostles feet. Dem share am to each, according to wetin each person need.
Joses, wey di apostles name Barnabas—wey mean Son of Encouragement—one Levite, man of Cyprus by race,
get farm, sell am, bring di money and put am for di apostles feet.
But one man wey im name na Ananias, with im wife Sapphira, sell property,
keep back part of di price, im wife know am too, bring one part, put am for di apostles feet.
But Peter talk say, “Ananias, why Satan fill your heart to lie to Holy Spirit, and to keep back part of di price of di land?
While you dey keep am, e no remain your own? After dem sell am, e no dey your power? How e take be say you plan this thing for your heart? You no lie to men, but to God.”
As Ananias hear these words, e fall down die. Great fear catch all wey hear these things.
Di young men get up wrap am up, carry am out bury am.
About three hours later, im wife enter, wey no know wetin happen.
Peter answer am, “Tell me whether you sell di land for so much.” E talk say, “Yes, for so much.”
But Peter ask am, “How e take be say una agree together to test di Spirit of di Lord? Look, di feet of di people wey bury your husband dey di door, and dem go carry you out.”
E fall down at once for im feet, die. Di young men enter find am dead, carry am out bury am by im husband.
Great fear catch di whole assembly, and all wey hear these things.
By di hands of di apostles many signs and wonders dey happen among di people. Dem all dey with one mind for Solomon porch.
None of di rest dare join dem; but di people honor dem.
More believers join Lord, crowds of both men and women.
Dem even carry di sick people go di streets, put dem on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter pass, at least im shadow go cover some of dem.
Di crowd come together from di towns round Jerusalem too, dey bring sick people, and di people wey evil spirits dey torment: and dem all heal.
But di high priest get up, and all di people wey dey with am, wey be di sect of di Sadducees, and jealousy full dem,
and dem put hands on di apostles, put dem for public custody.
But angel of di Lord open di prison doors for night, bring dem out, talk say,
“Go, stand talk for di temple to di people all di words of this life.”

When dem hear this, dem enter di temple about daybreak, and teach. But di high priest come, and di people wey dey with am, call di council together, with all di senate of di children of Israel, send to di prison make dem bring dem.
But di officers wey go no find dem for di prison. Dem return, report,
“We find di prison locked and secured well, and di guards dey stand before di doors, but when we open dem, we no find anybody inside.”
Now when di high priest, di captain of di temple, and di chief priests hear these words, dem confuse well about dem and wetin go happen.
One person come tell dem, “Look, di men wey una put for prison dey for di temple, dey stand dey teach di people!”
Den di captain go with di officers, bring dem without violence, because dem fear say di people fit stone dem,
and when dem don bring dem, dem set dem before di council. Di high priest question dem,
dey talk say, “We strictly command una say make una no teach for this name, and look, una don fill Jerusalem with una teaching, and una want bring this man blood on us.”
But Peter and di apostles answer, “We must obey God pass men.
Di God of our papa dem raise up Jesus, wey una kill, as una hang am for tree.
God lift am up with im right hand to be Prince and Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
We be im witnesses of these things; and Holy Spirit too, wey God don give to di people wey obey am.”
But dem, when dem hear this, e cut dem for heart, and dem decide to kill dem.
But one stand up for di council, one Pharisee wey im name na Gamaliel, teacher of di law, wey all di people honor, and e command make dem put di apostles outside for small time.
E talk to dem say, “Una men of Israel, be careful about these men, wetin una dey about to do.
Because before these days Theudas rise, dey talk say e be somebody; wey number of men, about 400, join imself. Dem kill am; and all, as many as obey am, scatter, and come to nothing.
After this man, Judas of Galilee rise for di days of di enrollment, and draw away some people after am. E perish too, and all, as many as obey am, scatter.
Now I dey tell una, stay away from these men, leave dem alone. Because if this plan or this work na from men, dem go overthrow am.
But if e na from God, una no go fit overthrow am, and una go even find say una dey fight against God!”
Dem agree with am. Dem call di apostles, beat dem and command dem say make dem no talk for di name of Jesus, and let dem go.
So dem leave di presence of di council, dey rejoice say dem count dem worthy to suffer dishonor for di Name.
Every day, for di temple and for house, dem no stop to teach and preach Jesus, di Christ.
Now for those days, as di number of di disciples dey multiply, complaint rise from di Hellenists against di Hebrews, because dem neglect dem widows for di daily service.
Di 12 call di crowd of di disciples, talk say, “E no good say we leave God word to serve tables.
So choose from among una, brothers, seven men wey get good report, full of Holy Spirit and of wisdom, wey we go appoint over this business.
But we go continue steadily for prayer and for di ministry of di word.”
These words please di whole crowd. Dem choose Stephen, man full of faith and of Holy Spirit, with Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, proselyte of Antioch;
wey dem set before di apostles. When dem don pray, dem put dem hands on dem.
God word increase and di number of di disciples multiply well well for Jerusalem. Big group of di priests obey di faith.
Stephen, full of faith and power, do great wonders and signs among di people.
But some people from di synagogue wey dem call “Di Synagogue of di Freedmen,” and of di Cyrenians, and of di Alexandrians, and of di people of Cilicia and Asia, get up, dey argue with Stephen.
Dem no fit stand against di wisdom and di Spirit by which e dey talk.
Den dem secretly induce men to talk say, “We don hear am talk blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
Dem stir up di people, di elders, and di scribes, come on am and catch am, bring am go di council,
and set up false witnesses wey talk say, “This man no dey stop to talk blasphemous words against this holy place and di law.
Because we don hear am talk say this Jesus of Nazareth go destroy this place, and go change di customs wey Moses give us.”
All wey sit for di council, dey fix dem eyes on am, see im face like say na face of angel.
